_doc: Medium batch m09 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

horned-viper/f:b3.note: sand kicked up around a burrow: puff, avoids a second drip (poison tag, viper still has Rattle Warn)

horned-viper/f:u2.note: rattle = buzzing zigzag warning, not a drip; best guess

rock-viper/f:b3.note: lichen spray: lichen is a plant, leaf over drip

rock-viper/f:u2.note: basking heat: sun-warmed rock, embers; best guess vs thorns tag

vine-snake/f:u2.note: whip flick of a vine-like body: leaf, avoids two drips with Ambush Spray

camel-calf/f:b1.note: stomp is a heavy foot slam: bash; Lanky Hoof Kick keeps slash

outback-dingo/f:u1.note: circling the prey: widening rings, no tag/keyword; best guess

savanna-hyena/f:u0.note: cackle = laugh zigzags (trip tag, but the laugh is the picture); best guess

striped-hyena/f:u1.note: bone drag is a scrape: slash, avoids third bash

striped-hyena/f:b3.note: puffed-up mane swells like a cloud: puff; best guess vs bash tag

warthog/f:b0.note: hook swipe of tusks is a slash; Tusk-Up Gore keeps the stab

warthog/f:b1.note: gore is an upward stab: thrust

warthog/f:u1.note: mud shove flings mud: drip (dark mud), avoids third bash

bison-calf-stampede/f:b1.note: stampede dust cloud: puff; best guess
